notes.title: New version [1.0] - Full release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34296591/bf1254adfefd529af3a687d8149f61c71d3df4f9.png[/img]

Hi there!

I've just uploaded the full release version 1.0.
First of all: thanks to all supporters during the Early Access. Your input really helped me to improve and extend the game in a cool way.

Since the end of March a lot of new features had been added. Here is a (not complete) list:

- NEW: New languages...French, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian & Chinese
- NEW: Lots of more football stats about your season
- NEW: When placing a building you now see overlapping areas for same type.
- NEW: Villa is now buildable by event and brings a gold player with longer career.
- NEW: Grid layout when build mode is active.
- NEW: New job concept introduced, added productivity to buildings.
- NEW: New funding concept.
- NEW: A college with scouting possibility can now be built.
- NEW: Price for building will be refund if it is deleted during the build process.
- NEW: New difficulties (previous difficulty was close to hard)
- NEW: New achievments
- NEW: Added animations for some buildings
- NEW: Job buildings are not highlighted when new apartments are about to be placed.
- NEW: New tutorial and task system.
- NEW: Burning apartments now have a possibility they don't burn down.
- NEW: New fundings and scrollable UI in Club house popup.
- NEW: Performance improvements
- NEW: Bus station now contain lanes. Bus stops can be placed in the city to reduce traffic.
- NEW: Football ground condition can get worse and needs to be repaired.
- NEW: Club house now contains jerseys.
- NEW: New income by jersey sales in the fan shop.
- NEW: New sound effects added
- NEW: New getting players mechanism (see new description for apartment in Tech-Tree)
- NEW: New Music! 4 new tracks including a new main theme.
- NEW: New save games will have the play time saved as well.
- NEW: OpenGL is now supported (previously DirectX).
- NEW: Shaders redone and improved.
- NEW: New shader & much better visibility in heatmap view.
- NEW: New text formatting engine.

- NEW: Game can now be continued from the start screen.
- NEW: Map can now also be moved with the arrow keys.
- NEW: There now is a figure to see apartment class numbers.
- NEW: New icons for apartment classes.
- NEW: TechTree removed and moved description to tool tip in building menu and popups.
- NEW: All team information now visible in Game screen.
- NEW: Children only join the club if at least one football pitch exists.
- NEW: League competition starts with first football pitch.
- NEW: Apartments always burn down when they caught fire (burning rate itself got decreased)
- NEW: Apartment can get renovated for a lower price than building it again
- NEW: Surrounded apartments can catch fire from long burning apartments.
- NEW: Name of currently placed object is now shown above building tab.
- NEW: Screen for credits has been added.
- NEW: Links to Discord and YouTube channel added to start screen.
- NEW: "Not enough jobs" tooltip in building popup shows what kind of jobs are needed.
- NEW: City name is now the default name for the save file.
- NEW: Textbox is focused when entering SaveGame screen.
- NEW: Game now has full hotkey support (see help popup).
- NEW: Game should now also run on Mac and Linux (will be available soon).
- NEW: New heatmap figures (Satisfaction, Trend and Gold/Silver/Bronze players).
- NEW: Buildings now show their road tiles while being placed.
- NEW: Apartments in radius will get focused when new building is about to be placed.
- NEW: Added engine extensions (e.g. TransitionControl for some key figures like money and revenue)

There have been a lot of fixes and updates as well but I don't want this announcement be too long.
I hope you will keep on playing the game, report issues and give me feedback how to improve the game even more.

Get in touch with me if you find any issues. Enjoy playing!

Cheers,
Christian

notes.title: Why there haven't been updates & the next steps
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34296591/7fc9e4569056b3a9f7e842b7b766a0ad3ed352d1.png[/img]

Hey Road to your City supporters,

as you might have noticed there was a time without game updates lately. There are [b]three reasons[/b] why there haven't been more updates for the game and I would like to make it transparent to you in this Steam announcement. 

[u][b]Reason 1:[/b][/u]
As you might know I've been working on the game for such a long time and the fact Road to your City was my first game also included that there have been so much new experience like putting the game on Steam, pushing the game in Early Access, doing some marketing, creating Youtube videos and stuff like that. I wanted to fix the main issues on the game and that´s what I did. But then I needed some time to clear my mind and to start playing games on my own since I haven't had any time during the development on Road to your City.

[u][b]Reason 2:[/b][/u]
I hardly get any feedback any more - neither bugs nor feature requests. That´s where reason three connects.

[u][b]Reason 3:[/b][/u]
The game was a success for me, since most of the time I had a full-time job and I was never dependent on earning a specific amount of money to proceed the development and so on. Of course I thought about working on the game full-time but I totally knew that Road to your City is more a niche game and it will be quite impossible that it might become the next Stardew Valley ;) But actually I did not care since I wanted to make that kind of game. But everything has an end and Road to your City is almost done because it´s fully playable. The sales were good but the progress shows me that there is not a huge interest in the game any more. That´s totally fine and I don't claim that, but I'm sure you understand that it doesn't make sense to work on a game no one is interested in any more. [b]I really appreciate all kind of support from the community I got over the years - that was really cool :)[/b]

But here is the thing: since [b]I would love to add more features[/b] to the game I offer you to [b]send me feature requests[/b] which will not fully break the game or might take months to make and I will see if I'm able to add them to the game. [b]After that Road to your City will finally come out as full release since the game itself - as already mentioned - is fully playable and bug free[/b].

So let me know in the comments, on my [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/BwTx373]Discord server[/url] or write me a message at [b]contact@yheekygames.com[/b].
Really looking forward to your messages!

Cheers,
Christian
